name: Donington Park Grand Prix Circuit
description: Donington Park in Leicestershire. The swooping downhill Craner Curves, the climb back up to Coppice, and the slow Melbourne hairpin and Goddards to finish.
direction_note: Points are ordered in race direction. Index 0 is the start/finish line.
raceline_source: modules/tracks/tools/raceline.py (minimum lap time, GT3 point-mass model)

elevation.source: Terrarium elevation tiles, AWS Open Data (SRTM, USGS 3DEP, national lidar), smoothed

barriers.source: OpenStreetMap barriers (1129 of 1598 edge points mapped) and gravel areas, defaults by corner and circuit style elsewhere
